_comment: Single input point for all domain data - read and validated by src/lib/data/domainData.ts. Every other module (the catalog, the DB seed script) consumes it through that loader, never this file directly. Three sections below: FUNCTIONS (the societal-function catalog), SCENARIOS (DB seed data), DEV_SEED_USER (dev login). JSON has no comment syntax, so '_comment'/'_section_*' keys are used as human-readable dividers - the loader strips them.
_section_functions: ===== FUNCTIONS ===== The catalog of societal functions ("kritiske samfunnsfunksjoner"). Each entry is self-contained - no shared/default table. functionalityTable: this function's OWN restoration curve - percent still functioning, keyed by [own category][day 1|3|7|30|90]. indirectImpactRow: this function's OWN impact-on-others matrix - keyed by [own category][every OTHER functionKey] -> the category it induces there. Both are still placeholder values (identical curve, naive self-mirroring rule) - TODO: replace with real data per function, and confirm each subtype.
_section_scenarios: ===== SCENARIOS ===== Predefined scenarios seeded into the DB by prisma/seed.ts (idempotent - safe to rerun after editing). Each scenario is a root "hendelse" (the event) plus the samfunnsfunksjon nodes it directly hits; purely-indirect functions are synthesized at request time from the FUNCTIONS catalog above, not listed here.
